definitions: A firm hold or a tight grasp
A part or handle by which something is held
Control or power over someone or something
An understanding or mental grasp of a subject
A person who moves equipment on a film set
examples: She loosened her grip on the railing.
The tennis racket has a leather grip.
The country is in the grip of a recession.
He has a good grip on the situation.
The key grip adjusted the camera dolly.
